verdict.rationale: Crossmint's documented agent products (Agent Cards, Agent Wallets, Agent Checkouts) are buyer- and agent-side tools: they let agents pay x402/MPP endpoints or check out at any merchant URL. No evidence shows a merchant-facing self-serve path, such as enabling a setting, signing an agreement, or publishing an agent-payable endpoint. The general headless checkout serves merchants accepting card and crypto payments, but it is not documented as a way to opt into agent traffic, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.
